# African Puzzle

> African Puzzle is a mobile app featuring puzzle games that celebrate African art, craft, and culture, with a marketing site available in five locales.

## Localized homepages

- [Français](https://africanpuzzle.com/fr/)
- [English](https://africanpuzzle.com/en/)
- [Nigerian Pidgin](https://africanpuzzle.com/pcm/)
- [हिन्दी (Hindi)](https://africanpuzzle.com/hi/)
- [العربية (Arabic)](https://africanpuzzle.com/ar/)
